summary: Add on-demand camera health probe (POST /api/cameras/health/refresh) that concurrently checks all cameras' reachability under a short capped timeout and returns fresh status; the web app calls it right after login so offline cameras (and their blank live-view tiles) resolve within ~3s instead of waiting for the debounced background sweep. N offline cameras cost ~one timeout window, not N
compatibility: Reuses the health monitor's TCP-first/RTSP-fallback probe; persists the latest status to the camera badge but leaves the debounced offline/recovery notification state machine untouched.
